#### PR description:

This is a port for PR: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51255

It fixes the LHEEventProduct::pdf_ conversion error as described in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/49538 .

#### PR validation:

The port is necessary for the EXONanoAOD v1 production for Run2 UL datasets.
